data.current_summary: Create a Bulk Fill export job
data.current_description: Submit a source PDF, a reusable `.doqlo` configuration package exported from the web Bulk Fill editor, exactly one row-data input (`rows_json` or `csv_file`), and a required `max_failed_row_percent`. Each accepted request is limited to 90 MiB total across recognized multipart file bytes and UTF-8 field-value bytes. Individual limits still apply and the narrower limit wins: PDF input is 20 MiB on Free and 80 MiB on paid plans, `.doqlo` uploaded and decoded payload bytes are 20 MiB on Free and 50 MiB on paid plans, and `rows_json` and `csv_file` are each limited to 10 MiB. Exactly 90 MiB is accepted; a larger accepted payload returns `413 MULTIPART_PAYLOAD_SIZE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`. Generated output is limited to 200 MiB on Free and 1 GiB on paid plans. Public API execution supports identity page organization only. Current payload schema v5 packages contain mapping configuration but no embedded CSV data or filename. Accepted legacy packages may contain CSV data, but it is ignored. Optionally supply `filename_columns` to append up to 3 CSV-driven suffix segments to each produced row PDF name while keeping the existing `row_{rowNumber}` prefix. Create requests must include `Idempotency-Key` for logical replay and may also include optional `X-Request-Id` for tracing.
data.summary_suggestion: Submit a Bulk Fill export job with PDF, configuration, and row data
data.description_suggestion: Initiates a new Bulk Fill export job by submitting a source PDF, a `.doqlo` configuration package, exactly one row-data input (either `rows_json` or `csv_file`), and a required `max_failed_row_percent` threshold. The operation accepts multipart form data with a total payload limit of 90 MiB (with plan-specific limits: PDF 20-80 MiB, `.doqlo` 20-50 MiB, row data 10 MiB each). Optionally specify `filename_columns` to customize output PDF names with up to 3 CSV-driven suffix segments. Returns a job ID for polling status and downloading results. Requires `Idempotency-Key` header for replay protection and supports optional `X-Request-Id` for request tracing. Output is limited to 200 MiB (Free) or 1 GiB (paid plans). Identity page organization only.

data.current_summary: Redeem the Doqlo-controlled download handle for a completed job.
data.current_description: Use `-L` or equivalent redirect-following support in your client because Doqlo may stream the file directly or return a redirect, depending on the current delivery mode. The ZIP artifact contains one produced row PDF per successful or partial row plus `manifest.json` version `2` with row-level status, counts, warnings, and row-fatal errors. Threshold-failed jobs never expose this route as a deliverable artifact.
data.summary_suggestion: Download the completed export job ZIP artifact
data.description_suggestion: Downloads the ZIP artifact for a completed export job. The artifact contains one produced row PDF per successful or partial row, plus `manifest.json` (version 2) with row-level status, counts, warnings, and row-fatal errors. The client must support HTTP redirects (use `-L` or equivalent) as Doqlo may stream the file directly or return a redirect. Note: This endpoint is not available for threshold-failed jobs.
